evidence.cashPf: normalized base-$1 PF on the same funded settled sample using canonical unit returns; should match Return PF
evidence.cashPfDiagnostic: actual sized-dollar PF on the same funded settled sample; unequal funded sizes can make it differ

statisticsScope.qualification: Base minimum-PF-qualified pairs, followed by post-Base config validation/seating
statisticsScope.benchmark: executed orders from the post-Base validated cohort
statisticsScope.candidatePool: pre-validation/unfiltered candidate PF is diagnostic only and excluded from primary benchmarks

qualification.note: Qualification uses the recorded full indication's runtime gates; Tactic minimum return PF 1.1, preserving stricter settings. No-loss qualification uses the runtime score 4.

returns.note: Direct walk-forward order returns exclude each recorded Block/coordination execution multiple; ladder/tape leg semantics remain. Cash, equity and sizing retain the stored weighted results.

caps.source: balance-volume defaults (no balance caps in the settings)

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close
